description: Every place the mod hooks Catherine's process. Only public Windows/DirectX entry points are used: no addresses inside Catherine.exe, so nothing depends on the game's version.

rows.purpose: Draw portraits, text boxes, Persona cut-ins and TV static over the frame.
Release overlay textures before a device reset (resolution change, alt-tab).
See which stage/area file Catherine opens (triggers) and swap the boss track (music).
Same as CreateFileW for ANSI callers.
Scale Catherine's clock for Sukunda and Garu.
rows._notes: Assumes Catherine times frames with QPC; timeGetTime is hooked too.

rows.purpose: Read mod hotkeys on the pad, hide them from the game, and press grab/pull for Garu.
rows._notes: Which XInput DLL Catherine imports isn't confirmed; the mod hooks whichever is loaded.

rows.purpose: Hide keyboard input from the game while a Team conversation or menu is open.
rows._notes: Only matters if Catherine reads the keyboard through DirectInput; the window-message filter covers the other case.

rows.purpose: Swallow key and raw-input messages to the game window while a Team conversation or menu is open.
Report keys as up to the game while a Team conversation or menu is open.
